# Rime Well, the frost tower: a round stone well, four short standing stones on its rim and a blue
# ice crystal floating over it. Origin on the ground at its centre; 1.45 m tall. make_env.py.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.6039 0.6039 0.5922 --no-slot
material new Water --base-color 0.2549 0.4157 0.6392 --no-slot
material new Ice --base-color 0.4863 0.6314 0.7529 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.3647 0.4078 0.4471 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.5000 --depth 0.5000 --name Well --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.2500
material assign Stone
add mesh cylinder --vertices 8 --radius 0.4000 --depth 0.0300 --name Water --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
translate 0.0000 0.0000 0.5150
material assign Water
add mesh cube --name Menhir0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.1500 0.1500 0.3600
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 45.00
apply --rotation
translate 0.2828 -0.2828 0.6800
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name Menhir1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.1500 0.1500 0.3600
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 135.00
apply --rotation
translate -0.2828 -0.2828 0.6800
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name Menhir2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.1500 0.1500 0.3600
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 225.00
apply --rotation
translate -0.2828 0.2828 0.6800
material assign Rim
add mesh cube --name Menhir3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.1500 0.1500 0.3600
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 315.00
apply --rotation
translate 0.2828 0.2828 0.6800
material assign Rim
add mesh cone --name CrystalUp --vertices 4 --radius1 0.22 --radius2 0 --depth 0.42 --location 0 0 1.16
material assign Ice
add mesh cone --name CrystalDn --vertices 4 --radius1 0.22 --radius2 0 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.82 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Ice
select Well
active Well
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export well.glb
